eras.title: Fragments of an ocean trade
eras.caption: Excavations at Pattanam recovered imported pottery alongside evidence of local activity and maritime connections. The site is a candidate for ancient Muziris; the finds illuminate Indian Ocean trade even while that identification remains debated.
